Section: Nimbus Labs Privacy Note > Individual requests

When a bank forwards a request from an individual (access, correction or erasure), Nimbus Labs responds to the bank within 15 days.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Security Whitepaper > Secure development

Engineers complete secure coding training once a year. Secrets are stored in AWS Secrets Manager and are never committed to source control; a secrets scanner blocks any commit that contains one.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Privacy Note > Roles

For the transaction data it processes for banks, Nimbus Labs acts as a data processor on the customer's instructions. The customer remains the data fiduciary.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Vendor Management Policy > Vendor tiers

Vendors are placed in three tiers:

Tier 1: handles customer data or is critical to running the platform.Tier 2: handles internal business data only.Tier 3: no access to company or customer data.

Nimbus Labs currently has 14 Tier 1 vendors.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Encryption Standard > Sensitive fields

Account numbers and UPI identifiers are additionally encrypted at the field level before they are written to the database, so they remain protected even in database exports.

Section: Nimbus Labs Data Retention Policy > Legal holds

If a legal hold applies, deletion is paused for the data in scope. The founder is the only person who can place or release a legal hold.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Privacy Note > Approach

Nimbus Labs designs Nimbus Ledger Sync for alignment with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023. This is a design goal, not a certification or a compliance statement.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Vendor Management Policy > Due diligence

Before a Tier 1 vendor is onboarded, Nimbus Labs reviews its security reports (for example SOC 2 or ISO 27001), signs a data processing agreement and records the review in the vendor register. The Engineering Manager approves every Tier 1 vendor.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Vendor Management Policy > Exit

When a vendor is removed, Nimbus Labs confirms in writing that data held by the vendor has been returned or deleted.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Encryption Standard > Customer-managed keys

Customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) are not supported in the current product. All keys are managed by Nimbus Labs through AWS KMS. This capability is not on the committed roadmap.

title: Knowledge Doc

Section: Nimbus Labs Privacy Note > Privacy contact

Questions go to privacy@nimbuslabs.example. Riya Sharma is the named privacy lead.

title: Knowledge Doc

Section: Nimbus Labs Security Whitepaper > What this document does not claim

Nimbus Labs does not currently run a public bug bounty program.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Security Whitepaper > Network and application security

Production runs in private subnets; only the load balancer is internet-facing.A web application firewall filters all inbound traffic.Every code change is peer-reviewed by at least one other engineer before it can be merged.Static code analysis and dependency scanning run on every pull request.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Incident Response Plan > Testing

The plan is exercised through a tabletop drill twice a year. The latest drill took place on 4 June 2026.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Vendor Management Policy > Change notice

Customers receive 30 days' advance notice before a new sub-processor is added. A customer may object in writing within that period.
